reader_summary.headline: This Sponsored Insight features Robert Boucai and James Broyer.
reader_summary.overview: This Sponsored Insight features Robert Boucai and James Broyer. They are the Co-Founders of Newbrook Capital Properties, a multifamily real estate investment platform built to generate optimal long-duration, tax-efficient income. Robert is also the Founder of Newbrook Capital Advisors.

key_points.text: Robert is also the Founder of Newbrook Capital Advisors.
He was born with sensorineural hearing loss and today serves on the Board of the Hearing Health Foundation.
Our conversation covers Robert's path from real estate to hedge fund investing and back to real estate.
